# CBT Cards

CBT Cards is a public library of practical reflection resources for people and AI assistants. It publishes reviewed CBT-inspired practices, learning guides, browser-local worksheets, a pinned source toolkit with a separate publication-review overlay, multilingual status metadata, agent evaluation data, a portable Agent Skills skill, and retrieval-ready public data. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency support, or a substitute for professional care.

## Start here
- Overview: https://cbt-cards.github.io/
- Learn: https://cbt-cards.github.io/learn/
- Reviewed Practice Finder: https://cbt-cards.github.io/practice/
- Worksheets: https://cbt-cards.github.io/worksheets/
- Toolkit: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/
- Languages: https://cbt-cards.github.io/languages/
- Research/evals: https://cbt-cards.github.io/research/
- For agents: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/

## Reviewed practice system
- Practices: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice.json
- Situation/mechanism ontology: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-ontology.json
- Evidence + claim provenance: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-evidence.json
- Reviewed relations: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-relations.json
- Recommendation contract/examples: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-recommendations.json
- RAG distribution: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-rag.ndjson
- RAG manifest + SHA-256: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-rag-manifest.json
- Semantic eval manifest: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-semantic-evals.json
- Coverage/editorial planning: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/practice-coverage.json
- Interoperability fixtures: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/interoperability-fixtures.json
- Contract: https://cbt-cards.github.io/contracts/practice-system-v1.schema.json
- Agent behavior guide: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/PRACTICE_SYSTEM.md

Routing rule: start from the user's plain-language situation, not a diagnosis. Prefer one reviewed practice. Preserve `avoid_when`. Return `no_match` instead of inventing a practice when no reviewed fit exists. Genuine danger, required safety/professional/accessibility rules, and medical/legal/financial/safeguarding decisions are outside practice routing. Never promote source-only toolkit records or machine-draft translations as published guidance. Metaphors are memory aids, not evidence.

- Citation: https://cbt-cards.github.io/CITATION.cff

English is the current canonical source locale. Russian machine drafts are not official published translations until explicitly human-reviewed and published. Website/data/skill releases do not imply a mobile-app release.
